sourceAttribution: Taro Tsuda, Sanae Yamashita, Koji Inoue, Tatsuya Kawahara, Ryuichiro Higashinaka (2025), Constructing a Multi-Party Conversational Corpus Focusing on Interlocutor Relationships, SemDial, pp193–202
use: Fresh supplementary source-disjoint human DEV; not R32 TRAIN, checkpoint selector, replacement gate or TEST

prospectiveSpeakerFold.rule: int(SHA256(UTF8(r32-mrmp-v1|speaker| + original public speaker ID)),16) mod100
prospectiveSpeakerFold.dialogue: Admit fold only if every original interlocutor has same fold. Cross-fold dialogues excluded. Speaker identifiers are pseudonyms, not identity inference; no profiles or attributes used.

acquisition: Pinned tarball; retain/hash exact dialogue raw files outside repo, LICENSE/README/VERSION. No profile file extraction. Parse reserved raw JSON only for speaker-ID/fold metadata; never encode, model-evaluate or semantically display reserved text.

contextEligibility.serialization: Original adjacent texts joined by one newline and terminal newline, no role/persona insertion
rejectContextContaining: ASCII controls except newline tab carriage-return

selection.perDocument: Lowest SHA256(r32-mrmp-prefix-v1|sourcePath|utteranceEndIndex) eligible context, no model generation/target scoring
selection.withinFamily: Rank source documents by SHA256(r32-mrmp-document-v1|sourcePath). Family is original dialogue ID first4 characters (speaker-combination series).
selection.acrossFamilies: Sort families by SHA256(r32-mrmp-family-v1|family); choose first ranked document from each family then second ranked document from each, round-robin until min8/all candidates.
selection.insufficient: Keep actual available count. Never change salt/folds/criteria or resample after outcomes.

evaluation.when: Only after actual R32 additional10000 optimizer updates; freeze probes in Git before any old/new generation
models: round32 lowest fixed original DEV NLL selected final
evaluation.generation: Identical unrestricted own-vocabulary greedy192, true EOS, Python1 thread; raw full outputs and JS comparison, no repairs

privacy: Language-only original utterances. No de-anonymization, impersonation, persona/profile/psychology/attribute use.
limits: Three-party chat is a different conversational setting; speaker identity across independent corpora not verified or inferred. Multiple source documents may share speaker combination; report effective families/subjects and do not treat8 as independent speakers. Source-disjoint does not certify absence of short/fuzzy wording overlaps.
